inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A pixel art sprite sheet of eight separate props from the emergency kit of a stranded alien civilization, each one whole with empty space around it, on a plain flat pale grey background, all seen from the front with a slight top down view, lit from the upper left. Their materials: pale pearly opalescent shell with iridescent scale cells, rose gold trims, dark gunmetal with thin glowing orange glyph seams, glowing violet and cyan lights. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "clean game sprites, readable silhouettes, coherent pixel clusters, compact sacred alien technology", "lighting": "Clear morning sun from the upper left, flat pixel colour planes.", "color_palette": ["#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#e0a070", "#2e2c38", "#f2a24a", "#6e32aa", "#78dcff", "#e2e6ec"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A plain flat pale grey background and nothing else: no ground, no sky, no shadows.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [52, 17, 429, 482], "desc": "the Glutton's bed of their alien technology: a long low heavy cradle of rose gold and pale pearly opalescent shell with iridescent scale cells, resting on four short pearly shell feet, thin dark gunmetal trims with thin glowing orange glyph seams, wide and shallow, empty"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [39, 508, 481, 654], "desc": "a regeneration tank of their alien technology: a tall glass cylinder full of glowing violet fluid with a spare mechanical arm floating inside it, on a dark gunmetal base with orange glyph seams, a pearly shell cap with a rose gold rim"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [20, 668, 502, 799], "desc": "a tall slim comms beacon of their alien technology: a dark gunmetal mast standing on a tripod of pearly shell legs, rose gold rings along it, a small glowing cyan light at its tip"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [65, 813, 481, 982], "desc": "a squat shield generator of their alien technology: a dark gunmetal drum ringed with glowing violet coils, a pearly shell dome on top with a rose gold crown holding a glowing violet crystal"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [533, 17, 968, 203], "desc": "three power cells of their alien technology standing together: dark gunmetal frames with glowing cyan cores and pearly shell caps"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [533, 218, 968, 450], "desc": "a small fabricator of their alien technology: a squat dark gunmetal base with glowing orange glyph seams, a rose gold printing bed, a pearly shell arch over it holding a small glowing cyan emitter"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [559, 465, 968, 726], "desc": "a medical cradle of their alien technology: a low pearly shell couch on a dark gunmetal stand, two thin rose gold arms with glowing cyan tips leaning over a spare mechanical leg lying on it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [559, 741, 968,
